content: simd-minimizers 3.1.0 (2026-10-26, MIT) is edition 2024 = requires Rust 1.85+, FAILS MSRV 1.80; seq-hash 0.2.1 edition 2024; packed-seq 5.1.1 depends on wide 1.7 (MSRV 1.89). v2.3.1 also edition 2024. v1.4.0 is edition 2021 + wide 0.7 + packed-seq 3.2.1 (edition 2021, wide 0.7, mem_dbg 0.3) - likely 1.80-compatible but unverified, and the library requires AVX2 or NEON at compile time (x64 needs target-cpu=x86-64-v3), no runtime dispatch, so opt-in native builds only. syncmers 0.1.5 dormant since 2022; fracsync 0.2.0 niche; digest-rs needs C++ digest lib. Recommendation: hand-roll KMC-style signatures; simd-minimizers as algorithm reference.
